summary:
Held 2 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 4 upside misses — BAB.L +11%, BAYN.DE +9%, TEP.PA +7%, DBK.DE +6%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (PUB.PA -5%, IFX.DE -5%, ASM.AS -4%, STMPA.PA -4%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: BAB.L (+10.95%) — UK defence stocks extending post-Defence Investment Plan rally (£300bn/4yr plan announced 30-Jun) ahead of NATO Ankara summit Jul 7-8; no single-name news today. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe — BAB.L is a UK mid-cap defence/naval services contractor, a sector the uk-eu strategies likely don't cover (focus skews large-cap diversified or non-defence industrials).
